name: marketing-09
title: Story told by the scroll
description: A Tidewell page told as five pinned chapters whose captions light word by word as each one holds, while a memo types itself out of redaction bars, hours tick up, a bar of busywork flips into judgment, roles step forward and a folder unfolds into a live checklist, and each chapter carries on by itself once the reader stops scrolling.
